6.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
6.text: "I have good news for you from our southeastern border."

7.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
7.text: "I come to you today with dire news from our southeastern border."

47.speaker: Player_Romus
47.text: "Esteemed members of the Alliance of Nations."

49.speaker: Narrator
49.text: Wiktor Smolak, President of Wehlen, got up from his seat to speak.

51.speaker: Narrator
51.text: He held his arms up in the air and shouted.

52.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
52.text: "As agreed with King Romus Toras, we will begin the transfer of the province of Zille back to the Kingdom of Rizia."

53.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
53.text: "Therefore, Wehlen hereby officially revokes the Alliance of Nations Threat Mitigation Protocol instituted in 1952."

54.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
54.text: "This protocol was previously employed by Wehlen to address the contentious issue of Zille's return."

55.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
55.text: "He did come around this time, it seems."

56.speaker: Player_Romus
56.text: "Maybe he is a man of his word after all."

58.speaker: Player_Romus
58.text: "He wouldn't dare to try any big moves here. He's the president of Wehlen, not Arcasia."

59.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
59.text: "Hmm. It would be wise to be careful until the very last second."

61.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
61.text: "So did His Majesty, King Romus. I congratulate him for being a man of his word as well."

62.speaker: Narrator
62.text: He looked at me and nodded.

66.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
66.text: "I will never forget the time my parents took me to visit Zille during my youth. It was a warm summer day-"

67.speaker: Narrator
67.text: He went on and on about his 'adventures' in Zille.

68.speaker: Narrator
68.text: After an eternity, he came back to the topic.

69.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
69.text: "Those were good times. But, yes. Anyway."

70.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
70.text: "The people of Zille have demonstrated their will to unite with Rizia one more."

71.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
71.text: "That much is clear from the incredibly popular pro-Rizia movements that have formed since we invoked the Threat Mitigation Protocol."

72.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
72.text: "That much is clear from the increasing popularity of the pro-Rizia movements that have formed since we invoked the Threat Mitigation Protocol."

73.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
73.text: "Dear Zilleans! I hear you in your call for the rule of law."

74.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
74.text: "This reunion happened despite the efforts of Lespia, which -- as many of you know and have conveniently decided to ignore -- attempted to sabotage the process."

75.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
75.text: "I can't help but mention one thing."

76.speaker: Alma Saltana
76.text: "President Smolak speaks the truth. Lespia's damaging interference can not be overstated enough."

77.speaker: Alma Saltana
77.text: "Morella vouches for Wehlen and Rizia's intentions regarding the transfer of Zille."

81.speaker: Alma Saltana
81.text: "President Smolak speaks the truth. Morella vouches for Wehlen and Rizia's intentions regarding the transfer of Zille."

82.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
82.text: "I would like to call for a round of applause."
82.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Demand_ZilleDiplomacy"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Morella_Allied"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Publicized_LespianInvolvement"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Publicized_LespianInvolvement_Rusty"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Demand_ZilleDiplomacy"] == true   or  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Morella_Allied"] == true) == false)

83.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
83.text: "For Wehlen. For Rizia. For the future of Zille."

87.speaker: Narrator
87.text: President Smolak left the podium, the applause still echoing in the chamber.

88.speaker: Narrator
88.text: An aide leaned over to my ear to let us know that it was lunchtime.

89.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
89.text: "He can't help making a dramatic entrance, can he?"

90.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
90.text: "I agree to ensure the legality of the transfer so that Zille returns to Rizia once and for all."

91.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
91.text: "I may have had to drag King Romus to the bargaining table, but it was all worth it."

92.speaker: Narrator
92.text: I heard a few laughs in the chamber.

93.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
93.text: "Your support is touching, Madam Prime Minister."

94.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
94.text: "Under Wehlen, the Zilleans have enjoyed democratic freedoms that they have never experienced before."

95.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
95.text: "To lose these freedoms by joining a monarchy... nobody wants that! Would you? I wouldn't!"

96.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
96.text: "I have heard representatives from Zille --personally, I might add. They were clear in their request."

97.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
97.text: "They asked good old Wiktor to help them out. And I promised that I would."

98.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
98.text: "Zille wants to remain part of Wehlen."

99.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
99.text: "King Romus Toras is knowingly, intentionally, sowing dissent among the populace of Zille!"

100.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
100.text: "The Kingdom of Rizia's continued demand for the transfer of Zille back to Rizian territory."

103.speaker: Player_Romus
103.text: "This is illegal! You are going against international law!"

104.speaker: Player_Romus
104.text: "Zille rightfully belongs to Rizia as per the agreement between our nations!"

105.speaker: Player_Romus
105.text: "Wehlen talking about democracy? You must be kidding me!"

106.speaker: Player_Romus
106.text: "You will not utter my name so easily, scoundrel!"

107.speaker: Narrator
107.text: President Nines hit the gavel a number of times.

108.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
108.text: "The monarch can't even keep himself composed in a democratic arena!"

109.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
109.text: "The will of the people is paramount in a democracy, King Romus, although you might not know that."

110.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
110.text: "A democratic referendum will take place in Zille so that the people themselves can decide with whom they will align."

111.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
111.text: "Wehlen is a full democracy, unlike your kingdom. I myself have been democratically elected four times!"

112.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
112.text: "You dare disregard the will of people? I can't say I am surprised."

113.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
113.text: "You're going to disregard the will of people? I can't say I am surprised."

115.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
115.text: "Rich, coming from a man who thinks his rule is law."

116.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
116.text: "I myself personally presented him with the idea of the referendum when it became clear that he was not interested in building trust between Rizia and Wehlen."

117.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
117.text: "With underhanded tactics, he has attempted to garner a pro-Rizia movement in the region. Its large size does not reflect Zille's true sentiments."

118.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
118.text: "With underhanded tactics, he has attempted to garner a pro-Rizia movement in the region. Its swelling numbers do not reflect Zille's true sentiments."

119.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
119.text: "Of course, Rizia has not sat idly by in the years since the Friendship Day Attack."

120.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
120.text: "He almost spat in my face. What do you expect from a monarch?"

121.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
121.text: "My government has found direct links to a massive underground armed resistance. Enough men to destabilize the entire region!"
121.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Zille_MassiveRiziaMovement"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Zille_GrowingRiziaMovement"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Zille_StrongArmedResistance"] == true)

122.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
122.text: "We found Rizian weapons in the hands of these terrorists! Where are these weapons coming from? Answer me!"

124.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
124.text: "My government has found direct links to an increasingly popular armed resistance."
124.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Zille_MassiveRiziaMovement"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Zille_GrowingRiziaMovement"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Zille_StrongArmedResistance"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Zille_GrowingArmedResistance"] == true)

125.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
125.text: "Not just in Zille! We also found Rizian weapons in the hands of BFF terrorists in Wehlen!"
125.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Zille_MassiveRiziaMovement"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Zille_GrowingRiziaMovement"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Zille_StrongArmedResistance"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Zille_GrowingArmedResistance"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_FundBFF"] == true)

127.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
127.text: "There are big games being played with Wehlen. Everyone is against us!"
127.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Zille_MassiveRiziaMovement"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Zille_GrowingRiziaMovement"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Zille_StrongArmedResistance"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Zille_GrowingArmedResistance"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_FundBFF"] == true) == false)

128.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
128.text: "Even Lespia has no qualms about helping a monarchy interfere with the will of the Zille citizenry!"

129.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
129.text: "That's right. His Majesty may try to pin the blame on our capitalist neighbors, but who's to say they were not working in tandem?"

130.speaker: Alma Saltana
130.text: "Are you going to believe the words of a dictator? This madman? Really?"

131.speaker: Narrator
131.text: Prime Minister Alma Saltana got up from her seat.

132.speaker: Alma Saltana
132.text: "How dare you of all people talk about democracy in these halls, Mr. President?"

135.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
135.text: "As a leading force for justice in the world, it is the AN's obligation to rescue these innocents from the clutches of their would-be King and deliver them to freedom!"

137.speaker: Narrator
137.text: He left the podium. President Nines motioned forward.

138.speaker: Narrator
138.text: I was given several minutes to defend Rizia's position. I made my way to the podium.

142.speaker: Player_Romus
142.text: "I would like to talk about the agreement that my father and President Smolak's predecessor signed all those years ago."

143.speaker: Player_Romus
143.text: "President Smolak demeans others with such ease, but let's talk about what he himself has done."

144.speaker: Player_Romus
144.text: "I can't help but respond to President Smolak's claims about what the people of Zille do and do not want."

158.speaker: Player_Romus
158.text: "In it, the territory of Zille was given to Wehlen for 25 years. Not a day longer."

159.speaker: Player_Romus
159.text: "Once the agreement expired, Wehlen had no legal basis by which it was entitled to hold the rights to Zille."

160.speaker: Player_Romus
160.text: "When circumstances were altered by the Friendship Day bombing, I gladly signed an extension to that agreement. But President Smolak did not honor even that."

161.speaker: Player_Romus
161.text: "It is long past time that Zille safely returned home."

162.speaker: Player_Romus
162.text: "Zille is Rizian, not Wehzek. Holding the rights to a territory temporarily does not make you own it."

163.speaker: Player_Romus
163.text: "I ask you this. What kind of world would this be if everyone went about making and breaking agreements with no consequences?"

164.speaker: Player_Romus
164.text: "This has been the number-one priority of my reign thus far."

165.speaker: Player_Romus
165.text: "If there is one resource we Rizians have in abundance, it is honor."

166.speaker: Player_Romus
166.text: "I will not let Wiktor Smolak hold my province hostage. No matter what."

167.speaker: Player_Romus
167.text: "Supporting this referendum would make a mockery of a legitimate, binding treaty between nations."

168.speaker: Player_Romus
168.text: "If President Smolak thinks he can get his way by bullying the region, he is wrong."

169.speaker: Player_Romus
169.text: "I have a personal connection to Zille and its people. I know that they will back me in this."

170.speaker: Player_Romus
170.text: "For his actions against the Bludish people, he should be regarded as a criminal."

171.speaker: Player_Romus
171.text: "He bullies everyone he can around him. Even his allies are not safe from his wrath."

172.speaker: Player_Romus
172.text: "He talks about democracy, yet look at Wehlen. It is a dictatorship of the few."

173.speaker: Player_Romus
173.text: "Go to any Bludish village in Wehlen and you will know what I mean."

174.speaker: Player_Romus
174.text: "Ask any Wehzek citizen who is not being held at a gunpoint by this man."

175.speaker: Player_Romus
175.text: "Just turn on your television or open a newspaper and you will see evidence of his misdeeds."

176.speaker: Player_Romus
176.text: "How can he be trusted? As shown by his behavior here, I will give the answer. He can't."

177.speaker: Player_Romus
177.text: "Wehlen has been victimized in the past, it's true. But that does not give Smolak free reign to become an oppressor."

178.speaker: Player_Romus
178.text: "Do you want this man to dictate what happens to Zille?

179.speaker: Player_Romus
179.text: "I say to you, the people of Zille will not suffer the same fate that the minorities in his own country do."

180.speaker: Player_Romus
180.text: "I will not let this caricature of a man take control of my mother's birthplace."

181.speaker: Player_Romus
181.text: "He is a dishonest, undignified, disreputable buffoon."

182.speaker: Player_Romus
182.text: "My mother was born in Zille. I know the region better than Wiktor Smolak or anyone else in this room."

183.speaker: Player_Romus
183.text: "I practically grew up in Zille. I still harbor close attachments to its residents."

184.speaker: Player_Romus
184.text: "The people of Zille are Rizian, and he should not run his mouth about our will."

185.speaker: Player_Romus
185.text: "So I say this to him. Do not try to lecture us about our own values."

186.speaker: Player_Romus
186.text: "It is not the Rizian monarchy that is a threat to the Zille people. It is Wehlen."

187.speaker: Player_Romus
187.text: "I have a hard time believing that Alliance of Nations would take the words of a lunatic this seriously."

190.speaker: Player_Romus
190.text: "I won't even indulge President Smolak's hallucinations about what is happening or not. I want to talk about this referendum."
190.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.ANZilleSpeech_Agreement"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.ANZilleSpeech_PeopleOfZille"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.ANZilleSpeech_Smolak"] == true) == false

191.speaker: Player_Romus
191.text: "I have said enough about Wehlen and the games President Smolak is playing. I want to talk about this referendum."

194.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
194.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.ANZilleSpeech_Agreement"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.ANZilleSpeech_PeopleOfZille"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.ANZilleSpeech_Smolak"] == true) == false

195.speaker: Player_Romus
195.text: "This referendum is a completely bogus attempt by Wehlen to gain control of more territory."

196.speaker: Player_Romus
196.text: "This referendum is instigated by President Smolak himself, not the people of Zille."

197.speaker: Player_Romus
197.text: "This referendum is completely illegal, unjust and out of line with previous agreements."

198.speaker: Player_Romus
198.text: "It should and will never come to pass."

199.speaker: Player_Romus
199.text: "Even if it is allowed to occur, the results should not be recognized by any state that is a member of this alliance."

200.speaker: Player_Romus
200.text: "Knowing the way that Wehlen's so-called democracy is run, there is no way their government will respect the actual will of the people."

201.speaker: Player_Romus
201.text: "I want you to put yourselves in Rizia's shoes. What would do if someone was trying to steal your land?"

202.speaker: Player_Romus
202.text: "I trust that Alliance of Nations will make the right call on this matter."

203.speaker: Player_Romus
203.text: "I am warning President Smolak. If he makes a single move to prevent the return of Zille, we will respond."

204.speaker: Player_Romus
204.text: "No matter what happens, I know that Rizia will come on the top. I have complete faith."

205.speaker: Player_Romus
205.text: "If we abide by the rule of law, what must be done is clear. Zille must be returned to Rizia as per the agreement."

206.speaker: Player_Romus
206.text: "Rizia will not be silent against the threat of Wehzek territorial ambitions."

207.speaker: Player_Romus
207.text: "I ask for your votes to send Alliance of Nations peacekeepers to Zille to stop this illegal referendum."

208.speaker: Player_Romus
208.text: "With or without the help of Alliance of Nations, we will defend our territory. You can be sure of that."

209.speaker: Narrator
209.text: The audience applauded as I stepped down from the podium.

210.speaker: Narrator
210.text: I went back to my seat next to Laurento.

213.speaker: Player_Romus
213.text: "All I did was tell the truth."

216.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
216.text: "Let's see what the member states decide."

217.speaker: Narrator
217.text: After much deliberation, President Nines opened the floor. Each leader now had to vote whether to allow the referendum or not.
